7th Dragon III Code - VFD.name: 7th Dragon III Code: VFD
7th Dragon III Code - VFD.summary: 7th Dragon III Code: VFD is an upcoming game in the 7th Dragon series of Japanese role-playing games. It will allow players to choose from eight jobs and 32 appearances for their party members, and 40 battle voices. 7th Dragon III Code: VFD is set in three time periods: the past, the present, and the future.

Power Rangers - Megaforce.name: Power Rangers Megaforce
Power Rangers - Megaforce.summary: For as long as evil has threatened the Earth, there have been teams of Power Rangers sworn to protect it. The Power Rangers Megaforce are the planet's newest defenders. For the first time, experience the next chapter in the Power Rangers legacy in 3‐D! Plus power up your rangers with the all‐new card scanning feature!

RPG Maker Fes.name: RPG Maker Fes
RPG Maker Fes.summary:
"Are you ready to become a game developer?

Create the RPG you always dreamed of with RPG Maker Fes!

RPG Maker Fes is a game creation software that lets you create your own RPGs, at anytime and anywhere, on the Nintendo 3DS system without any programming knowledge.

Moreover, all your completed RPGs can be uploaded and then downloaded to be played by other Nintendo 3DS users for free!

In order to download and play other users' creations, please visit the Nintendo eShop and download the free software RPG Maker Player."

Viking Invasion 2 - Tower Defense.summary: The sequel to the critically acclaimed Viking Invasion!
